lyrics:
[Intro: pitched-down warped voice, hazy synth, vinyl crackle]
Out of the blue
Out of the blue

[Verse 1: soft, close, slow heavy beat enters]
Road shimmer, ice-cream van
I was laughing with a drink in my hand
Then a song from a passing car
And I'm back, I'm back where you are

[Chorus: falsetto on top, warped synths, deep bass]
Cold snap in July, out of the blue
Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater
Can't make it warmer, can't make it better
Cold snap in July

[Verse 2: soft, a little heavier]
You'd want me happy, I can hear you say it
I've got the summer and I don't know how to play it
Garden full of people, table full of food
And a draught only I walk through

[Chorus: falsetto on top, warped synths, deep bass]
Cold snap in July, out of the blue
Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater
Can't make it warmer, can't make it better
Cold snap in July

[Bridge: beat drops out, voice and guitar, tape wobble]
It passes
It always passes
I let it stay a while
I let it

[Final Chorus: full, extra harmonies, guitar line]
Cold snap in July, out of the blue
Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater
Can't make it warmer, can't make it better
Cold snap in July

[Outro: warped voice, crackle, children playing far off]
Out of the blue
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 81 BPM, 4/4, B major. Slow, heavy and hazy. Everything bends slightly, like air over hot tarmac.

VOICE: Male tenor, soft and intimate, with a breathy falsetto on the chorus top line. His voice is doubled with copies that are pitched down or wobble slightly out of tune. The intro and outro use a slowed, warped version of the same voice.

INSTRUMENTS: Wobbling, detuned synthesiser chords. A slow, hard-hitting hip-hop drum beat with a deep kick and a snappy snare. Heavy sub-bass. A clean, twanging electric guitar line. Vinyl crackle and tape flutter. Distant outdoor sounds.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the warped voice and hazy synth. 0:15 Verse 1, the beat enters. 0:45 Chorus 1. 1:15 Verse 2. 1:45 Chorus 2. 2:15 Bridge, no beat, voice and guitar with tape wobble. 2:30 Final chorus with harmonies. 3:00 Outro, the warped voice and far-off children playing, ending at 3:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s psychedelic pop with hip-hop drums: thick, warm and deliberately unstable in pitch, bass very deep, vocals close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The slowed, warped voice in the first five seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The bridge is the older voice: it passes, it always passes, and he lets it stay a while. That is how grief is carried decades on, at a garden party with a full table.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Ease, ambush, ache, acceptance.
